tei:div.tei:p: (ja)༄༅// mnoharāpādagatiḥnāmadz+nyeyas+yadashas+yashakaṃprash+not+tarabidzahāraṃ//

༄༅// shes bya'i gnas kyi dogs pa dris pa'i lan ldon yid 'phrog rkang stabs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// li khri'i rdul tshogs brtsegs pa'i lhun po la// 'char ka'i mi sbyin skyes 'od kyis 'khyud pas// dar bab sku yi dge mtshan brgya stong char// co 'dris dben pa 'jam dbyangs bla mas skyongs// kun mkhyen bstan pa'i lha gnas blar 'degs shing*// skal bzang gdul bya'i chu gter klong du brjid// phrin las 'jig rten mig gi 'od rnon gyis// don gnyis lhun grub 'dab stong ci yang bzhad// gang blos sna tshogs shes byar dpyad pa'i ngor// rnam dpyod som nyi'i yul la 'phyan pa'i mchid// dri za'i lus phra'i 'gyur khug glu bas kyang*// ches cher sgra 'dzin 'jebs pa'i snyan dngags son// 'dzum dkar bsu'o zla bas sa mos tshal// sgyu ma'i gzugs 'phrul ltad mos byis pa'i bzhin// gtsug lag sbyangs rnams 'phyang mo nyug gi gnas// dris don gang dag nges pa'i lan ldon gyis// blo dang ldan pas shes byar mi dpyad na// mong rtul blun po'i blo yis spyod yul min// lta byed ldan pas gzugs kyi mtshan nyid la// mi dpyod na ni dmus long ci byar yod// de'ang 'dir lung dang rigs pa'i drang thig gi rgyud nas/ phyi nang rig pa'i re khā dgye dgur dpyod pa'i dbang phyug rag nyag sprul pa'i sku skal bzang phrin las lhun grub pa'i mkhyen klong du shar ba'i dogs gnas byung ba'i bka' mchid kyi dri ba nyung shas phebs par/ gang dag rang blor nges snyam gyi phyogs re nas gsung lan 'bul ba la/ bka' 'dri dang por/ nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i chos 'byung nyis brtsegs tshul phyi nang du bsgom tshe/ 'di 'dra zhig 'byung na mdun rgyab spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa bsgom pa ji lta bu dang*/ bsnol ma la/ 'di ltar phyi nang gi 'phrod tshul nang ma phyir thal ba lta bu 'byung ba ji lta bu/

'di dag dmar gtor khong stong mgo mjug bzlog pa lta bu'am dbyibs gzhan yin/ zhes phebs par/ de la gsung lan 'bul ba/ gser chos mkha' spyod ma'i thugs ka'i chos 'byung nyis brtsegs zhes pa/ dper na gtor ma zur gsum khong stong mgo mjug bzlog pa lta bu la/ nang ma'i gdong zur gcig rang gi mdun phyogs su bstan pa/ phyi ma'i gdong zur gcig rgyab phyogs sgal tshig gi dbus drang por bstan pa'i tshul du bsnol ma ltar yod pa/ gnyis ka'ang che chung gtan med pa zhig yin gyi/ che chung yod pa'i rnam pa can ma yin te/ ji ltar na/ kun rdzob tha snyad mthun par thig 'debs tshul ltar na/ sa gzhi ngos mnyam par shar nub dang lho byang gi tshangs thig btab la/ lte ba'i thig 'dzoms su/ lag pa g.yon pas thig skud bzung*/ g.yas pas che chung gang byed tshad kyis thig skud rdo dkar bcas pas zlum por bskor la/ nub kyi tshangs thig dang zlum skor phrad par g.yon pas thig skud bzung*/ g.yas pas thig skud rdo dkar dang bcas pas dbus kyi lte bar slebs pa'i tshad de nyid kyis/ lho byang gi zlum skor steng du gar slebs kyi rtags re byas/ rtags de gnyis kyi steng nas nub ngos kyi 'phred thig gdab/ yang rtags de gnyis steng nas shar gyi tshangs thig dang zlum skor phrad par thig btab pas gru gsum rtse mo shar du bstan pa 'byung*/ de bzhin du shar gyi zlum skor dang tshangs thig phrad par g.yon pa'i thig skud gzung*/ g.yas pas thig skud rdo dkar bcas pas lte bar slebs pa'i tshad de nyid kyis lho byang gi zlum skor steng rtags re byas/ rtags de gnyis steng nas shar gyi 'phred thig gdab/ yang rtags de gnyis steng nas nub kyi tshangs zlum phrad par thig btab pas/ gru gsum rtse mo nub tu bstan pa 'byung ste/ des ni chos 'byung nyis brtsegs 'phel kha che ba'i tshad 'byung zhing*/ de dag gi gdong zur rnams lte 'og bar du 'dzom pa'i tshad du thig gdab pa ltar je zhum du song bas gtor ma zur gsum mgo mjug bzlog pa'i rnam pa 'byung ngo*// des na chos 'byung phyi nang gi tha snyad mas kyi rtse mo la khyad par cung zad min pa'i dbye ba med kyang*/

zur rtse mdun drang por bstan pa de phyi ma dang*/ zur rtse gcig rgyab phyogs su bstan pa de nang mar byed cing*/ de dag gi grwa zur bzhi po gzhogs g.yas g.yon la bstan pa'i tshul du yod pa khrid yig rnams nas 'byung ba ltar yin la/ chos 'byung nang ma'i zur phyi ma'i phyi rol du thal ba lta bu 'byung ba ni mi 'gal te/ lam gyi gnas skabs kyi bsgom bya thams cad snang tsam rang bzhin med pa 'ja' 'od kyi rnam pa can yin pas 'od kyis 'od la mi 'gog pa'i phyir/ de dag kyang kun rdzob tha snyad pa'i blo dang mthun pa tsam du bsgom pa'i tshul yin gyis/ rnal 'byor pas ting nge 'dzin gyi rtsal 'don pa'i phyir/ chos 'byung phyi nang che chung gtan med par byas kyang rung*/ chos 'byung phyi ma chung ngu'i nang du/ nang ma shin tu chen po zhig bsgoms kyang*/ phyi ma che ru ma song*/ nang ma chung ngur ma song yang nang du mi chud pa'i dogs pa mi 'char ba zhig la'ang bslab dgos te/ bskyed pa'i rim pa mthar phyin pas/ gcig mang por sprul pa dang*/ mang po gcig tu sdud pa dang*/ stong gsum yungs 'brur sdud pa la yungs kar cher ma song*/ stong gsum chung ngur ma song ba dang*/ rdul phran gcig gis 'jig rten khams thams cad khengs pa la rdul phran cher ma song*/ 'jig rten khams chung ngur ma song yang der chud pa la 'gal ba med pa ste/ 'jam dpal khro chen gyis bstod pa las/ stong gsum chen por yungs 'brur sdud// rdul phran gcig gis 'jig rten 'gengs// zhes 'byung ba lta bu'i 'bras bu'i dus kyi yon tan rnams da ltar lam gyi dus nas goms par byed dgos pa'i phyir/ de ltar bshad ma thag pa lta bu'i chos 'byung bsnol ma'i mdun rgyab kyi rtse mo gnyis kyi nang du dga' 'khyil spangs pa'i/ zur rtse bzhi'i nang gi grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa dkar po/ g.yung drung ris zlum por 'khyil ba lta bu'i rnam pa can/

grwa'i phan tshun gang du'ang ma reg par bar snang du yod pa'o// des mtshon bya ye shes dga' ba bzhi mtshon te/ bzhi ni dga' ba dang*/ mchog dga' dang*/ dga' bral dang*/ lhan cig skyes dga'i ye shes bzhi ste/ kye rdo rje las/ sna tshogs dang po dga' ba nyid// rnam smin la ni mchog dga' nyid// rnam nyid dga' bral dga' ba nyid// mtshan bral lhan cig skyes dga' nyid// ces 'byung ba'i phyir/ bka' 'dri gnyis par/ sa bon dang sngags kyi mdun ngos 'dzin tshul gang zhes phebs par/ gsung lan 'bul ba/ chos 'byung gi dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dgod bya'i sa bon ni/ da lta'i bod yig dbu can bris pa lta bu'i bam̐ ste/ de'ang bam̐ gyi khog pa/ mgo bo/ zla tshes/ thig le/ nā da ste cha lnga pa'i rnam pa can/ de'i mdun ngos mthong ba'i ngos de mdun yin pa las gzhan pa'i g.yas g.yon rgyab kyi khyad par yod pa mi bzhed de/ dper na/ me long gi gzugs brnyan nam chu zla ltar mthong ba'i ngos de mdun yin pa las/ rgyab dang g.yas g.yon gyi tha snyad mi 'byung ba lta bu'o// de bzhin du mtha' skor gyi sngags phreng rnams kyang kha dog dmar po dbus kyi bam̐ yig la phyogs pa'i tshul gyis langs thabs su yi ge gnyis gnyis ldog pa la/ ye ni tsa zhes pa yig 'bru gsum ldog par khrid yig nas 'byung ba lta bus bskor ba yin no// bka' 'dri gsum par/ phyi'i chos 'byung gi sgo gang yin zhes phebs par/ gsung lan 'bul ba/ phyi rol gyi chos 'byung rnam par thar pa sgo gsum gyi rang bzhin stong pa nyid mtshon byed yin pas logs gsum po de la sgo'i tha snyad gdags su rung ba tsam las/ gzhan lta bu'i sgo 'phar sgo'i 'gram sgo logs la sogs pa dngos su yod mi dgos te/ de'i logs gsum ni stong pa nyid dang*/ mtshan ma med pa dang*/ smon pa med pa'i sgo stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir/ bka' 'dri bzhi par/

thun mtshams sogs su phyag mtshan dang rgyan med dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ji ltar zhes phebs par/ gsung lan 'bul ba/ mnyam gzhag gi rnal 'byor las ldang ba'i thun mtshams spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor dang ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyi dus dang*/ dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i skabs thams cad du/ rang rje btsun ma phyag mtshan med pa'i skur langs zhes sam/ ngo bo phyag mtshan med pa'i skur ldang*/ zhes pa tsam las rgyan spangs par ma bshad pa tsam zhig ni sa skya pa chen po la sogs pa yi ge phal cher las 'byung ba ltar/ ngor chen yab sras sogs kyi yig cha las kyang de bzhin 'byung bas/ de ltar byed pa'ang*/ a bhi dha na las/ rang gi lhag pa'i lhar sbyor ba'i// zhes dang*/ kye rdo rje sogs las kyang*/ rang gi lhag pa'i lhar sbyor bas// bdag dang gzhan la mchod pa gyis// zhes bya ba sogs rgya cher 'byung ste/ de dag ni thun mong du rig pa'i dbang lnga thob pas kyang*/ dngos kun gang dang gang snang ba// gtso de rang gi lhag pa'i lha// chos rnams rang bzhin gyis dag pa// sangs rgyas ye shes blta bar gyis// zhes bshad pa ltar de phyin chad tha mal gyi snang ba thams cad brtul nas/ ye shes kyi snang ba las grub pa'i lhag pa'i lha'i 'khor lor blta dgos par bshad na/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang bzhi bcas rdzogs par thob pa'i steng du/ grol lam bsgom du rung ba'i rang sems rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yin pa la yin par ngo sprad pa'i byin rlabs khrid bcas thob pas/ snang grag rig pa'i chos su snang ba thams cad lha sngags ye shes gsum gyi sgyu 'phrul rol par rtogs nas nyams su len dgos par som nyi ci zhig ste/ kye rdo rje las/ rmongs phyir 'khor ba'i gzugs can nyid// rmongs med 'khor ba dag pas na// 'khor ba mya ngan 'das par 'gyur// byang chub sems ni mya ngan 'das// zhes dang*/ slob dpon ār+ya de was/ 'khor ba mya ngan 'das pa zhes// de nyid ma mthong ba yi sems// 'khor med mya ngan 'das med ces// de nyid mthong ba rnams kyi sems// zhes sogs rgya cher 'byung ba'i don du snang ngo*// lha sku de'ang phyag mtshan med pa'i skur ldang ba ni/

rje btsun ma rang nyid shes rab stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin dang*/ thabs he ru ka'i ngo bo bde ba chen po'i ye shes dbyer med pa'i bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes de nyid/ gzung 'dzin la sogs pa spros rtog gi mtshan ma kun gyis ma bsgribs par thugs su chud pa'i don te/ a bhi dha nar/ phag mo'i gzugs ni mtha' yas pas// spros dang bral ba'i sdom pa'o// zhes 'byung ba de nyid/ rang gi rgyud la'ang mngon du bgyid pa'i don du gzung ngo*// des na phyag mtshan spangs pa'i skur ldang ba las/ rgyan spangs pa sngon gyi yig cha rnams su bshad pa med pas rgyu mtshan cher med par phyis su ngag sgros 'byams pa zhig yin nam snyam mo// bka' 'dri lnga par/ bsam mi khyab thun mong min pa'i skabs su/ a ho me wa swa yaṃ badz+ra sogs kyi sngags 'byung ba/ 'di'i rgyu mtshan dang gzhung gang nas 'byung zhes phebs par/ gsungs lan 'bul ba/ ji skad gsungs pa'i a ho me wa sogs yod pa ni/ bsam mi khyab kyis mtshon pa'i 'dir bzhugs kyi glegs bam rnams su sngags kyi tshig de 'dra yod snyam med par/ btsal yang ma rnyed pas bsam brjod yul du ci bgyir yod/ bka' 'dri drug par/ 'dzin med du 'jog ces pa dang*/ had de 'jog ces pa 'ga' yang byung ba don du 'di skor gyi bsgom tshul ji ltar zhes phebs par/ gsung lan 'bul ba/ 'di dag ni chos dang gang zag gi bdag dang gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gis stong pa'i mtha' bral gyi ngang du mnyam par 'jog pa'i don du ste/ de ji ltar bsgom pa'i tshul nyid kyi thugs la gsal mod/ 'dir gsung lan mi ldog tsam zhig las zhib par bshad kyis mi ldang mod/ mdor bsdus 'bul na/ de'ang laṅkar gshegs pa las/ bag chags kyis ni dkrugs pa'i sems// don du snang ba rab tu 'byung*// don yod ma yin sems nyid de// phyi rol don mthong log pa yin// zhes gsungs pa ltar/

phyi nang snod bcud 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad byed pa po gzhan med par/ rang gi sems nyid thog ma med pa nas 'khrul pa'i bag chags kyis bslad pa'i dbang gis snang ba kho na las don du snang ba 'ga' yang med de/ dper na rmi lam gyi snang ba lta bu ste/ de skad du mdo ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ mi dag rang gi khyim na rmi lam bzhin// 'dod pa'i yon tan dag gis dga' myos kyang*// phyis sad nas ni de yis 'dod ma myong*// de ni rmi lam yin pa de yis shes// de bzhin mthong thos rig dang bye brag shes// 'di dag thams cad mi bden rmi lam bzhin// zhes so// gal te bag chags ji tsam brtan yang yun ring ba dang shin tu 'thas pa 'di ltar mi rigs so snyam na/ de ni bag chags brtan mi brtan gyi bye brag tsam ste/ tshad ma rigs gter las/ don du snang ba blo nyid yin// snang ba de nyid phyi na med// bag chags brtan dang mi brtan la// bden dang rdzun pa'i rnam gzhag byed// ces so// 'o na phyi don mi bden pa de ltar na/ don snang gi sems nyid bden par grub pa yin nam zhe na/ de yang ma yin te/ 'jug pa las/ mdor na ji ltar shes bya med de bzhin// blo yang med ces don 'di shes par gyis// zhes gsungs pas/ gzung yul grub pa med pa nyid kyis/ yul can sems kyang ma grub ste/ de dag ni ltos nas grub par gzhag pa'i phyir yang don la ma grub pa nyid de/ de nyid las/ phan tshun don la ltos pa'i grub pa ni// grub min yin zhes dam pa rnams kyis gsungs// zhes 'byung ba'i phyir/ gal te de ltar na gnyis stong gi shes pa de nyid bden pa'i dngos por grub pa zhig gam snyam na/ de'ang ma yin te/ dgag bya gzung 'dzin gnyis ma grub pas/ de bkag pa'i gnyis stong gi shes pa zhig kyang bden par yod par grub pa mi srid de/ yod na yod pa gang gis shes/ rang nyams su myong dus so zhe na mi 'grub ste/

'jug pa las/ gal te gzugs med 'dzin pa nyid bral ba'i// gnyis kyis stong pa'i gzhan dbang dngos yod na// 'di yi yod pa gang gis shes par 'gyur// ma bzung bar yang yod ces byar mi rung*// de nyid kyis de myong bas grub ma yin// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rnam pa gcig tu na/ rang la rig bya rig byed gnyis tha dad du grub par yod na/ ral gri'i sos kyang rang nyid gcod du btub par 'gyur te/ de ltar na/ spyod 'jug las/ ral gri'i so ni rang la rang*// ji ltar mi gcod de bzhin yid// ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na sems ni skye 'gag gnas gsum thams cad dang bral ba ste/ 'das pa'i sems ni zhig nas med pa'i phyir med pa dngos por ga la rung*/ ma 'ongs pa'i sems ni ma skyes pas ma skyes pa dngos por grub pa ci'i phyir mi 'gal/ da ltar gyi sems ni gcig dang du ma gang yang ma yin/ kha dog dang dbyibs su ma grub/ lus kyi phyi nang bar gsum gang du'ang mi gnas/ ji ltar btsal yang mi rnyed pa'i phyir/ ma rnyed pa de yod par ci zhig grub ste/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ gsang ba'i bdag po/ sems ni sangs rgyas rnams kyis ma gzigs/ mi gzigs/ gzigs par mi 'gyur te/ sems ni sngon por ma yin zhes sogs dang*/ 'od srungs kyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ 'od srungs sems ni yongs su btsal na mi rnyed de/ gang mi rnyed pa de ni mi dmigs so// gang mi dmigs pa de ni 'das pa yang ma yin/ ma 'ongs pa'ang ma yin/ da ltar byung ba'ang ma yin no// gang 'das pa'ang ma yin/ ma 'ongs pa'ang ma yin/ da ltar byung ba'ang ma yin pa de ni dus gsum las yang dag par 'das pa'o// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de dag dang mthun par rje btsun rin po che grags pa'i zhal snga nas kyang*/ sems thog mar skye ba med pa la// gnas pa dang 'gag pa ga la srid// skye 'gag med par bsam pa yang*// rnam rtog yin gyi zhog la thong*// bzhag pa rang yang zhog la thong*// 'jog pa rang yang rnam rtog yin// zhes so// de ltar na yod pa dang med pa gnyis 'gal ba'i phyir yod med gnyi gar ma grub/

de ma grub pas gnyis ka bkag pa'i gnyis min du'ang mi 'grub ste/ sems kyi gnas lugs ni mtha' bzhi'i spros pa dang bral ba ste/ ye shes snying po kun las btus pa las/ yod min med min yod med min// gnyis ka'i bdag nyid min pa'ang min// mtha' bzhi rnam par grol ba yi// de nyid dbu ma pa yis rig /ces 'byung ba ltar/ spros pa dang bral bar shes pa'i shes rab dang ma bral bas/ ci'i ngo bor yang mi 'dzin pa de'i ngang du 'bad rtsol lhod nas 'jog ces pa'i don to// tshul de lta bu'i sgo nas mtha' bral du legs par gtan la 'bebs pa'i lhag mthong so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab dang ldan pas/ nyams su blang bya'i lam thams cad kyang de dang de'i rang bzhin las ma 'das par shes nas nyams su len pa nyid shin tu gtso che ba nyid du go dgos te/ spyod 'jug las/ yan lag 'di dag thams cad ni// thub pas shes rab don du gsungs// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ skabs su babs pa'i gsung don yang*/ des na chos thams cad spros bral du rtogs pa'i lta bar legs par sbyangs pa'i shes rab dang ldan pas/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi skabs lta bu/ bla ma rang la bstims nas de kho na nyid kyi ngang du mnyam par 'jog pa na'ang*/ bla ma dang rang sems dbyer med du bsres nas/ sems kyi ngo bo la cher bltas pa na/ sems kyi gshis cir yang ma grub pa nyid ni stong pa nyid/ gdang 'gags med mos gus su lam mer 'char ba ni gsal ba/ stong gsal gnyis gnas pa gcig gi ngo bor gnas kyang so sor dbyer med pa ni zung 'jug de gsum ldog pa tha dad kyang so sor 'di'o zhes tshig gis brjod du med pa ni brjod bral/ blo'i yul las 'das pa ni/ blo 'das de'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag pas/ don dam pa'i bla ma sku bzhi zung 'jug gi rang zhal mthong bar gyur pa na/ der 'dzin pa ma zhugs par 'jog ces pa'am/ der ma bcos gnyug ma'i gnas lugs mtha' bral gyi ngang du 'jog ces pa'i don yin gyis/

ri bong gi rwa lta bu'i ci yang med pa'i ngang du had de 'jog pa'am/ bden gnyis zung 'jug tu rtogs pa'i rnam dbye ci yang ma chags par/ ya bral phyogs re ba la'ang shes rab kyi snang ba dang bral yang der zhen pa/ ji skad du sdud pa las/ thabs med shes rab bral bas nyan thos nyid du lhung*// zhes pa dang*/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ stong nyid nyan thos rnams kyang bsgom// de yi 'bras bu 'gog pa thob// ces dang*/ blun pos phyag rgya che bsgom pa// phal cher dud 'gro'i rgyu ru 'gyur// ces bya ba la sogs pa rmongs bsgom byed pa rnams ltar 'jog pa'i don du bshad pa ni ma yin no// bka' 'dri bdun par/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs skabs/ rdul tshon dang sin+dhū ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi rdul tshon gyis/ slob ma'i gnas gsum du reg pa'i skabs/ ri mo sngags rnams byid song bar skyon mi 'byung ngam/ zhes phebs par/ gsung lan 'bul ba/ sin+dhu ra'i sngags 'di rnams lha bskyed gzhi tshom bu lta bu ste/ rjes gnang gi skabs 'gar byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir tshom bu nas sbyin pa lta bu yin la/ de'ang gsung gi byin rlabs kyi tshe yig 'bru'i sin+dhu ra nas sbyin pa'i tshe lag pa g.yon pa'i srin lag gi rtses yi ge dbyi ba lta bur mi byed par/ rdul tshon la mnan pa'i tshul gyis len pa yin pas/ yig 'bru'i ro ma lus tsam 'ong ba las gtan nas phyis pa ltar mi 'gro zhing*/ shes rab ye shes kyi byin rlabs kyi tshe grwa bzhi'i dga' ba 'khyil pa nas rdul tshon len pa yin pas/ de'ang snga ma dang mtshungs par blangs nas sbyin pa'i tshul byed pa yin pas mi gnod pa yin nam snyam ste/ de ltar byed pa phyag len la'ang mchis pas/ ting nge 'dzin gyis bskyed pa'i lha dang bskyed gzhi tha mi dad pa yin pa'i phyir/ dper na tsa ka li la sogs pa dbang rdzas lag tu 'grims pa lta bu yin pas mi gnod pa yin nam snyam mo// bka' 'dri brgyad par/

'dod rgyal gyi nor bu gsal 'bar 'don cha bklag chog dang dpe ris bcas dka' bzhi dpal ldan bzang pos mdzad pa dang*/ 'dod rgyal dpe'u ris tshang ma g.yar po gsungs pa dang*/ nyin srung mtshan srung gi sngags pa dang sa sogs nor ba 'ga' byung bas/ sngags tha dad bkrol nas sngags yongs rdzogs shig bris gnang zhes phebs par/ gsung lan 'bul ba/ dka' bzhi pas mdzad pa'i bklag chog gi dpe yod min ma nges pa dang 'dod rgyal dpe'u ris tshad ma sde dge'i phyag la tshang rgyas shig bzhugs pa thos shing*/ de min dpe'u ris tshang rgyas gzhan du bzhugs pa ma shes/ 'di phyogs la kha 'thor re gnyis min pa 'phral du ma rnyed pas ci bgyir ma byung zhing*/ slad mar rnyed pa byung na yid 'jog bgyid/ nyin srung mtshan srung gi sngags 'di dag spyir pra kṛ ta'i skad dang zur chag 'dres pa 'byung ba 'di rigs la/ phyi mo mi 'dra ba gnyis gsum gtugs nas zhu dag cung zad tsam min pa/ saṃ skṛ ta'i brda dang bstun pa'i bzo bcos byar mi btub/ 'on kyang gsung bzhin 'di phyogs kyi dpe gnyis gsum dang gtugs pa'i zhus bstar byas pa dang*/ de'i mchan 'grol yang don thob kyis byas pa ltar mchis pa bcas zur du bris nas phul yod par/ der rgyal dbang lnga pa sogs nas byung ba'i dpe rgyun yid brtan rung ba bzhugs na gtugs mdzod/ bka' 'dri dgu par/ rigs byed ma gaṅgā'i chu rgyun du thod phreng pho nya mo gsal bas mnan gsungs pa pho nya mo bsgom tshul ji ltar zhes phebs par/ gsung lan 'bul ba/ gaṅgā'i chu rgyun zhes pa'i dpe de mdzad pa po su yin ngos ma zin zhing*/ 'dir yod kyi dpe gras rnams su btsal yang de sngon lag tu son pa ma byung bas da lam lan gsal 'bul tshod ma theng yang*/ nyid nas dmigs bsal ma rnyed na las byed dang 'gugs byed kyi pho nya mo 'di rigs rang gis sprul pa'i pho nya mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa zhig spros te dngos grub dgug par bsam pas chog par sems so// bka' 'dri bcu par/

gsang sngags sgra'i rjes gnang la 'khor lo dgu brtsegs dgos sam zhes phebs par/ gsung lan 'bul ba/ kag chol gsang sngags sgra'i rjes gnang la rmor chen pa nas rang gis thob dus/ 'khor lo g.yogs dang bcas pa zhig 'grims byung ba de dus su/ rtsad gcod thub pa zhig ma byung bas dgu brtsegs dgos sam ma yin gsal kha de sngon nges gsal yi ge ma mthong bas/ thag chod zhu 'os ma rnyed la/ slar mthong thos yid ches byung tshe rim gsal bgyi ba dang*/ cis kyang ma rnyed tshe/ rjes gnang gi tshe phyin chad 'khor lo 'di rnams la brten nas dbang gi phrin las gang 'dod sgrubs shig ces pa'i brda mtshon yin pa'i dbang du byas na 'khor lo gang yod spel tshig yod pa bcas bris nas rab gnas bcas song ba cig gtod dgos sam snyam mo// bka' 'dri bcu gcig par/ nyid nas mdzad pa'i lha mchog gsum gyi bsang mchod de'i/ 'dod rgyal skabs su/ rgya skyegs me tog dkyil nas phyung ltar dmar// lcags kyu zhags pas lag brel brkyang bskum zhabs// gsungs pas yum bde rgyas ma'i mtshan sgra byung na bsam par/ dgongs par babs tshe tshig kha skong bka' drin skyongs zhes phebs par/ gsung lan 'bul ba/ kho bos byas pa'i bsang mchod cho ga sde bzhi'i dga' ston 'jo ba'i dbyar ring zhes pa der/ yum bde rgyas ma'i mtshan dngos su yod de/ dug can 'khyog por 'phye ba'i do shal byas// dbang gi dga' bdeṃ rgyaṃl maṃ'i lang tsho'i dpal// rgya skyegs me tog dkyil nas phyung ltar dmar// zhes pa de nyid kyis 'thus lags/ 'on te de'i rtsom gdan gyi steng nas yig mkhan gzhan gyis/ tshig rkang chad lus song ba yin shas yod bsams nas 'di gar par du brkos pa las par btab nas phul yod pa/ 'dren byed dbang po'i yul du 'bebs pa 'tshal lo// bka' 'dri bcu gnyis par/ sdeb sbyor dzā ta'i skabs/ yang ba dang*/ 'phrod ma la/ tsa gsum rnams kyis zung min rkang pa dag

rdzogs par gyur tshe sogs kyis rtsa gsum gyi rkang pa rdzogs rgyu dang*/ mi rdzogs rgyu bod skad kyi rkang pa la dang*/ gsum la ji ltar yod pa'i legs sbyar rdzogs dgos mi dgos lags so// zhes phebs par/ gsung lan 'bul ba/ sdeb sbyor dzā ti'i nang gsel 'phags ma 'phrod ma dang*/ yangs ma gnyis la/ 'phags ma spyi'i skabs kyi/ gal te 'dab ma tshogs brgyad rnams// mi mnyam rnams la dza spangs 'phags mar 'gyur// phyi ma phyed la drug pa ka'o gnyis ka yi// brgyad pa da ste lhag ma tsa rnams so// zhes pa'i don rkang pa gnyis bsdams pa'i tshigs bcad kyi phyed snga phyi gnyis ka dag gi 'dab ma tshogs brgyad re yod pa'i/ tshogs mi mnyam pa ni dang po dang gsum pa dang lnga pa dang bdun pa rnams la dza dbus lci ba spangs pa dang*/ phyed phyi ma la drug pa'i tshogs ka yin pa dang*/ phyed snga phyi gnyis ka dag gi tshogs brgyad pa da yin pa ni 'phags ma spyi yin te/ de ni 'og gi dmigs bsal ma gtogs pa thams cad la khyab par shes dgos la/ de'i nang gsel 'phags ma 'phrod ma'i sdeb sbyor dper brjod ni/ phyed sngar drug la dza'am kha'o kha la ni/ dang po la ni yang ba'i ngal gsor 'gyur// kha pha rol la drug pa'i mthar ngal gso'o// zhes pa ltar te/ drug pa'i tshogs dza yig tu byas pa'i mdo snga ma 'phags ma'i skabs bzhin no// yang na drug pa'i tshogs kha yig tu byas pa de'i tshe de'i dang por yang ba'i ngal gso ba dang*/ drag tshogs kha yin pa 'di las pha rol te bdun pa'ang kha yig tu bya ste/ de'i drug pa de'i mthar yang ngal gso bya ba dang*/ phyed phyi ma la bzhi pa'i pha rol te/ lnga pa kha yin pa de'i tshe tshogs bzhi pa'i mthar ngal gso ba dang*/ 'ang gi sgras drug pa'ang ngal gso bya zhing*/ bdun pa'i tshogs khar gyur pa'i tshe drug pa la yang ba phyi mo gcig pa'i ngal gso ba bya'o// de'i tshe tsa gsum rnams kyis zung min rkang pa dag

/gang tshe rdzogs pa de tshe 'phrod mar 'gyur// zhes pa 'dir yar drangs te/ tsa'i ming can bzhi'i nang gi dza ma gtogs pa'i tshogs gsum rnams kyis/ zung ma yin pa ste rkang pa dang po dang gsum pa dag yongs su rdzogs pa de'i tshe 'phrod mar 'gyur te/ ༄// sin+dhūwarakūṭagiriṃbhaskaramaliṅgakaramapi.udayakaraiḥshubhalak+ṣamekashamahomañdzurutabisamaṇagurudzayatu//

༄// sin+dhū wa ra brtsegs pa'i ri bo la// snang byed 'char ka'i 'od kyis 'khyud byas kyang*// dge legs mtshan gyi ngo mtshar cha shas rer// bsgrun du med pa 'jam dbyangs bla ma rgyal// zhes pa lta bu'o// de bzhin du/ yangs ma'i dper brjod ni/ sdeb sbyor gzhung gi dkyus su/ tsa gsum rnams kyis zung min rkang pa dag /gang tshe rdzogs pa de tshe 'phrod mar 'gyur// gal te zung min gcig kyang rdzogs min pa// de rnams kyis ni de tshe yangs ma yin// zhes pa'i don no// 'di'i tshigs bcad 'don yangs ma'i dper brjod yin par bshad pas/ gang gi tshe tsa yig gsum gyis zung ma yin pa'i gcig kyang ma rdzogs pa de'i tshe yangs ma zhes bya ste/ de'ang zung min gcig kyang zhes pa'i kyang gi sgras zung min gnyis ka bstan la/ des na tsa gsum gyis zung min ma rdzogs par/ tsa bzhis rdzogs pa de'i tshe/ sdeb sbyor yangs ma zhes bya ba ste/ dper brjod na/ ༄// shitamaṃshunābanāḥkumudo3hasarekhāshasharūso3tsitraṃ/ kān+taduhalās+yapūr+ṇaṇasaraswatitsit+tān+tāmar+habhagi/ ༄// bsil ba'i zer gyis ku mud tshal mi bzhad// ri bong gzugs kyi ri bo bkra min par// mdzes sdug 'jo sgeg rdzogs pa mtsho ldan mas// skal ldan snying gi 'thibs bu'i dgra mngon bcom// zhes pa 'di'i zung min gnyis ka'i legs sbyar tsa bzhis rdzogs pa lta bu'o// bka' 'dri bcu gsum pa/ 'di phyogs su sa skya'i 'bul sdud pa rnams kyis rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang*/ khram zhu mi gang byung la gnang gin 'dug pa ha cang gu yangs pa'i skyon i yod snyam pa ji ltar/ 'di rnams kyi som nyi'i drwa ba/ mkhyen rab kyi 'od kyis bsal du gsol// zhes phebs par/ gsung lan 'bul ba/ 'bul sdud pa rnams kyis zhu mi su byung la gnang ba de/ sngon gyi dus na slob mas bla ma brtags/ bla mas slob ma brtags nas dbang bskur ba'i lugs srol byung ba ltar mdzad mkhan byung na shin tu legs te/

de skad du'ang*/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ nyi ma gcig gi bza' btung la'ang*// bzang ngan rtog dpyod sna tshogs gtong*// gos dang mkhar lhan la sogs pa'i// bya ba gang la'ang legs nyes dang*// bzang ngan mkhas dang mi mkhas zhes// blang dor rtog dpyod sna tshogs byed// rta dang nor bu la sogs pa// cung zad tsam gyi nyo tshong la'ang*// kun la 'dri zhing brtags nas dpyod// tshe 'di'i bya ba cung zad la'ang*// de 'dra'i 'bad pa byed pa mthong*// skye ba gtan gyi legs nyes ni// dam pa'i chos la rag las kyang*// chos 'di khyi yi zas bzhin du// bzang ngan gang du'ang mi dpyod par// gang phrad de la gus par 'dzin// zhes gsungs pa ltar te/ deng dus de tsam du ma zad/ so thar/ byang sdom/ sngags kyi sdom pa thams cad la'ang cung zad spyod pa gu yangs skyon lta bu 'byung ba 'dug mod/ ci bgyir ma mchis par lus 'dug 'on te de dag la/ 'gro mgon 'phags pas/ 'jam dbyangs ral gri la spring bar/ bstan pa 'phel 'grib 'byung ba rgyal bas gsungs// sems can bde skyid rang rang las la rag /gang la gang 'dul de la der ston pa// 'di gsum ma gtogs mkhas pa min par go /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bla mas kyang bstan pa'i rgyun gnas pa'i bsam sbyor dang*/ gdul bya sems can rnams kyang dbang gral du gang yod la phan thogs pa'i nges pa yod med gang shes kyang*/ skal ba dang ldan pa 'ga' zhig la phan 'dogs mi 'byung ba'i nges pa med de/ ji skad du/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ bskal ba bye ba du ma ru// sngon chad sdig pa byas pa gang*// dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong ma thag /de dag zad par 'gyur yin na// grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i// tshul la gnas na smos ci dgos// skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni// go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur// zhes sogs 'byung ba lta bu la dgongs pa dang*/ slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid kyang rgyud sde rin po che rnams nas mang du bshad kyang mdor bsdu na/

ji skad du/ sngags dang rgyud dang man ngag shes// cho ga'i las la rab tu mkhas// snying rjes slob ma rab 'dzin pa// dbang bskur ba yi slob dpon mchog /ces gsungs pa lta bu'i nang nas/ cho ga gang yin pa de la ma rmongs shing brgyud pa'i lag len la mkhas pa zhig dang*/ snying rje'i sems cung zad med na/ theg chen gyi slob dpon du mi 'gyur ba gdon mi za zhing*/ khyad par gsang sngags kyi rdo rje slob dpon la mtshan nyid de tsam med pa zhig gis rdo rje slob dpon byed pa'i thabs ci zhig yod/ de bzhin du/ slob ma'i mtshan nyid kyang rgyud sde rnams nas mang du 'byung ba'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa dus kyi dbang gis shin tu rnyed par dka' na'ang*/ de nyid las/ dad dang snying rjes sems rab dul// rnam rtog nyung zhing blo dang ldan// sngags kyi lam mchog don gnyer ba// zhes gsungs pa tsam gyi nang nas kyang*/ dad pa med na/ dkar po'i chos kyi gzhi med par// de'i rgyud du thar pa'i sa bon 'jog tu ci zhig rung*// des na chos dang bla ma dkon mchog la dad pa yod dgos pa'i phyir dang*/ snying rje'i sems bag chags tsam yod na/ sngar theg chen gyi lam du ma zhugs pa'i slob ma la sngags lam gyi skabs su bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i thabs thun mong ma yin pa dbang gi sta gon dang 'jug pa'i skabs nas thob pa yod pa des kyang thus la/ sngags kyi lam mchog don du gnyer ba'i blo med na dbang bskur zhu don ma mchis pa la/ kho rang rnams kyis gsol ba btab nas gnang ba thob pa de tsam gyis thus par sems shing*/ gcig tu na/ gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ bde gshegs gsang sngags sgrub pa la// don gnyer brtson pa'i slob ma ni// gzugs ngan yon tan mi ldan yang*// blo dang ldan pas gzhug par bya// zhes gsungs shing*/ kye rdo rje las/ mtshams med lnga ni byed pa dang*// srog chags gsod la dga' ba dang*// gzhan yang skye ba dman gang dang*// rmongs dang ma rungs las byed dang*// gzugs ngan yan lag ma tshang dang*// bsam pas de rnams 'grub par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa ltar/

thabs la mkhas pa'i khyad par la brten nas/ 'bras bu bla na med pa'i rdo rje theg pa'i lam la don gnyer gyi mos blo yod pa tsam gyis/ mtshan nyid gzhan ci rigs pa ma tshang na'ang 'jug tu rung ba de lta bus kyang 'grub par gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/ rang re'i bod kyi yul 'dir rigs dman pa rnams la'ang rtog dpyod cher med mod/ 'phags yul du ni rigs bzang ngan sgo nas dbye ba chen po byed srol yod tshul mchis mod/ sngags kyi dngos grub sgrub pa la ni/ l+h+wam mkhan dang*/ ko mkhan dang*/ gdol pa sogs rigs dman pas kyang sngags lam la brten nas/ dngos grub mchog brnyes pa mang du byung ba mchis pa'i phyir dang*/ lhag par dbang bskur ba ni sngags kyi sgor dang por rgyud ma smin pa smin par byed pa'i dbang gi cho ga nyid yin pa'i phyir ro// des na dbang bskur ba 'di las kyang*/ dbang bskur ci yang ma thob pa'i rigs la byin rlabs dang rjes su gnang ba zab mo mang du byed pa 'di ni/ yongs su ma smin sems can la// gsang ba sgrogs pa bdun pa yin// zhes gsang sgrogs kyi ltung ba 'byung ba sogs nyes pa che ba tsam du mngon mod/ ci byar ma mchis shing*/ bod yul 'dir dbang bskur thob min che phra kun gyis kyang gsang sngags yi ge drug pa 'don pa sogs kyang phan yon dang nyes dmigs gang che shes dka' ba tsam du mchis so// slob ma'i grangs kyang*/ gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ mkhas pas slob ma gcig gam gsum// lnga'am yang na bdun dag gam// nyi shu rtsa ni lnga yi bar// zung du ma gyur slob ma gzung*// zhes grangs gcig nas nyer lnga'i bar kha yar ba re dgos par bshad la/ der slob ma nyer lnga las mang ba mi rung bar bshad pa ni rgyud sde 'og ma la dgongs pa yin gyi/ slob dpon sā dhu pu tras/ slob ma gcig gam/ gnyis sam/ mang por gyur pa rnams zhes gsungs pa ni/ rnal 'byor bla med la dgongs so// zhes bla ma rnams gsung ngo zhes mkhas grub chen po bu ston gyis gsung las 'byung ba ltar/

rdo rje phreng ba 'di la'ang de ltar du grangs nges med byed srol byung mchis/ der ma zad deng dus 'ga' zhig so thar gyi sdom pa len pa la'ang dang por rab tu 'byung rung mi rung gi dri ba la'ang dris don thams cad yin pa'i nges pa yod med gang shes kyang*/ thams cad kyis ma yin pa yin zhes lan 'debs pa tsam gyis thus par byed pa dang*/ ris bdun gyi sdom pa len pa la nges 'byung gi bsam pa skyed dgos pa dang*/ sdom pa len pa'i tshe na'ang so so'i thob mtshams go ba dang gtong ba'i rgyu shes pa dang*/ dge tshul gyi sdom pa len par/ dgag pa'i tshul gyis 'gal rkyen bar chad bzhi spang ba/ sgrub pa'i tshul gyis mthun rkyen lnga tshang ba sogs dgos pa dang*/ de dag gi bslab byar slob tshul shes pa sogs ji bzhin tshang ba rnams sngar nas sbyangs pa can 'ga' re ma gtogs thams cad la mi 'byung ba dka' ba tsam snang ba dang*/ de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa la'ang dbu ma lugs dang sems tsam lugs gnyis las/ dang po la 'phags pa klu sgrub zhabs kyi lugs la byang sdom len pa po brda shes shing don go ba tsam nas lha klu la sogs pa 'gro ba thams cad la sdom pa skye bar bshad pa dang*/ bsam pa'ang tha na 'jigs skyob legs smon tsam las kyang skye bar bshad pa dang*/ skye ba'i rgyu'i gtso bo phal cher 'dra yang*/ tshe 'di'i 'jigs skyob bdud sdig can la/ lag na rdo rjes bsdigs pa dang*/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis bskul bas g.yo sgyus kyang skye bar gsungs pa lta bur bzhed pas gu yangs pa ltar gsungs la/ 'phags pa thogs med zhabs kyis ni/ rten so so thar pa'i sdom ldan du dgos par gsungs pa ltar na gling gsum gyi skyes pa bud med kho na min pa gzhan la mi skye ba dang*/ bsam pa'i rten yang skyabs 'gro khyad par can las skye ba dang*/ rgyu ni mdo las 'byung ba thams cad byang chub sems dpa'i sar bsdus nas rigs phun sum tshogs pa dang*/

dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis zin pa dang*/ snying rje che ba dang*/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis 'jigs pa ste rgyu bzhi dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan la mos pa dang*/ theg pa chen po'i chos thos pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i chos nub tu nye ba mthong ba/ sems can nyon mongs par mthong ba ste rkyen bzhi dang*/ rang dang gzhan gyi bsam pa dang sbyor ba'i stobs bzhi ste bcu gnyis su gsungs so// de'ang mgon po byams pas/ grogs stobs rgyu stobs rtsa ba'i stobs// thos stobs dge ba goms pa las// mi brten pa dang brtan 'byung ba// gzhan gyis brten pa'i sems bskyed 'dod// ces gsungs pa ltar/ dbu sems gnyis po so so'i gzhung bzhin dgos par bshad kyang*/ de nyid ha cang gu dog pas 'ga' zhig 'phags pa'i lugs dang khyad par med tshul lta bur bzhed pa dag gis/ sems tsam lugs kyi sems bskyed kyang slob ma'i mtshan nyid gzhung bzhin bsam sbyor sogs dang ldan mi ldan ji ltar na'ang kun la sdom pa 'bogs pa lta bu'o// de'ang sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ sangs rgyas bstan dang 'gal ba yi// chos log du ma deng sang 'phel// 'di la mkhas rnams mi dges kyang*// dus kyi shugs kyis bzlog ma nus// zhes gsungs pa'ang tshul 'di dag la dgongs pas los yin snyam mo// des na dbang bskur ba la'ang gsang sngags kyi lam la don du gnyer ba'i mos pa dang*/ gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob 'dod kyi 'dun pa ming gdags su rung ba yod tsam la dbang bskur ba mi rung ba med pa tsam du sems kyang*/ 'on kyang dus dbang gis ji skad smras pa'i sdom pa gsum ka'i bslab bya dam tshig sdom pa'i bsrung sdom rnams tshul bzhin byed mkhan shin tu dkon pa ltar snang ba 'di la ni cir 'gyur shes dka' ba tsam du mchis mod ci bgyir yod/ de ltar phyi nang rig pa'i gnas la dpyod pa'i dbang phyug nyid kyi mkhyen klong du shar ba'i dogs gnas byung ba'i bka' 'dri nyung shas phebs par/

gang dag rang blor nges pa'i gsung lan ci rigs pa rnams sug bris su bgyis zin to// 'dir smras pa/ phyi nang shes bya'i dogs gnas phra mo yang*// shes rlom zol gyis snying gar mi sbed par// 'dri rmad tshul gyis brtsad dpyod bgyi ba 'di// thams cad mkhyen gnas 'dod pa yongs kyi las// e ma dka' gnas 'dri dang lan ldon dag /mchid du bgro la gna' dus mkhas pa'i las// da dung 'di na mchis snyam tshangs sras mo// longs spyod 'khor lor yibs te mnyan nam snyam// gzhung lugs sbyangs stobs mi dman a sho ka /rnam par dpyod pa'i 'dab lag rab rdzogs kyang*// som nyi'i rgya nang yur ba dpyad gsum gyi// yid phrog rkang stabs kyis bsnun rnam par bkrol// dge bas log rtog tshar gcod gzhan rjes 'dzin// kun shes rig pa yan lag bcas pa'i don// ji bzhin rtogs nas mkhas pa'i tshul gsum gyis// bde 'byung rgyal bstan rgyas pa'i byed por shog /gtong phod rmad byung byang chub spyod phyir dang*// brtse dang byang chub sems kyis ring dben pas// 'gro ba'i re skong dpag bsam rkang 'thung gis// gzhar yang 'gran min khyod zhabs brtan phyir bsngo// ces shes bya'i gnas kyi dogs pa dris pa'i lan ldon yid 'phrog rkang stabs zhes bya ba 'di ni/ lnga rig sbyangs pa'i dpyod ldan sprul pa'i sku mchog skal bzang phrin las lhun grub pa'i gsung bskul rab snyan tam+bu ra'i dbyangs kyis phebs pa'i ngor/ thu ma'i srol 'dzin ban+de tshul khrims rin chen nam/ 'byung du rung ba'i yon tan la smon pa'i tshul gyis/ ngag gi dbang po 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha/ dbyangs can snyems pa'i lang tsho'i sder bod pas lhun grub steng gi gtsug lag khang mthong na mngon par dga' ba'i nye 'dabs kyi bsti gnas su/ rab byung 'dod pa'i mi zad ces bya ba'i bgrang gzhi shar ba'i zhag mdzod rgyu skar gyi bu mo sa gas nya ba'i zla tshes dge bar bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ bha ba tu//
